messages:
Alex: Heads-up — release cutoff is ~48h (Fri 10:00 PT). We need coordinated version bumps across api, runtime, console, and SDKs. Please confirm PR merges/tags and any compatibility notes now. I'll lock branches 1hr before the window.

Priya: API PR #452 is review-ready, just needs changelog entry and a tag. planning v1.9.0 for API. I'll open the changelog PR in a few mins.

Marco: Runtime will require a breaking change to KV cache layout (perf win). I'm preparing a compat shim, but this means runtime goes v2.0.0. Running the full test matrix now, might hit quantization breakage.

Taylor: Console is fine with the new surface, but SDK constructors change too. Suggest we keep console as a minor bump and publish SDKs with updated types after API 1.9.0 is cut.

Alex: Proposal: cut runtime v2.0.0 with compatibility shim + automated fallback; bump API to v1.9.0; bump SDKs to v0.12.0; console gets minor bump only. Any blockers?

Priya: Works for API. I'll add a migration snippet to the changelog and call out runtime compatibility. Example changelog snippet:

```
API v1.9.0 — 2026-03-20
- Added X/Y endpoint for adaptive routing
- Note: Compatible with runtime v2 when fallback is enabled. See docs/migration/runtime-compat.md
```

Marco: CI alert: build/runtime-tests failed on branch runtime/v2-bump — https://ci.internal/build/12345. I'm triaging; if I can't fix by EOD I'll open a rollback/respin plan.

ci-bot: Build FAILED — runtime/v2-bump — https://ci.internal/build/12345 — failing suite: quantize-integ

Taylor: SDK PR #98 updates client constructor. If API is 1.9.0 I can publish SDK 0.12.0 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Publish command I use:

```
# from sdk repo
npm version 0.12.0 -m "release: %s"
npm publish --access public
```

Alex: Action items:
- Priya: changelog + migration doc
- Marco: fix CI or open rollback plan
- Taylor: coordinate SDK release after API tag
- I'll prepare GH release drafts and lock branches 1hr before window

If anyone needs a different plan, raise it now otherwise we ship this cadence. :thumbsup:

Priya: I'll add the changelog PR in ~10m and ping for LGTM.

Marco: updating CI fix, will ping eng-runtime for help.

Taylor: noted, will queue SDK release. 👍
